# ledger_merchant (Data Source)

Reads one Ledger merchant by identifier or by display name. Merchant routes need an API token with the administrator-only `merchants:read` and `merchants:write` grants (merchant names derive from bank text).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By display name (ignoring case); archived and merged merchants are found too.
data "ledger_merchant" "grocer" {
  display_name = "lidl"
}

# Or by identifier.
data "ledger_merchant" "by_id" {
  id = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The display name, matched ignoring case; it is returned as written. Archived and merged merchants are found too. Set `id` or `display_name`, not both. An alias that is not the display name is not looked up here; use `id`.
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier. Set `id` or `display_name`, not both.

### Read-Only

- `aliases` (Attributes List) The alias names transactions are matched by. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aliases))
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether it is archived (a merged merchant is archived).
- `archived_at` (String) When it was archived (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `merged_into` (String) The identifier of the merchant it was merged into, or null.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.

<a id="nestedatt--aliases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aliases`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When it was added (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) The alias identifier.
- `key` (String) The name as matched: NFC, white space collapsed, lower case.
- `name` (String) The alias name.
- `origin` (String) `user`, `decision` or `upgrade`.
